flags.person: Kelly Neal (appointed board member; not a candidate)
flags.summary: At the June 9, 2026 meeting, after public comment on a proposed administrative reassignments item that had been removed from the agenda, Neal said board members are human beings who should be treated with respect and kindness. According to the minutes, she said none of them should have been threatened, called names or shamed into voting one way or another, and that she appreciated those who raised concerns respectfully. Superintendent Prusiecki read a statement saying he was disappointed with the comments made to board members and to him.
flags.note: Candidate Tessa Key was among the five residents who spoke on the item. The minutes do not tie Neal's remark to any speaker and do not record what anyone said. Editors should decide whether the episode belongs in race context. The current text mentions only the removed item and the superintendent's statement.

sources.title: Regular Session Minutes, June 9, 2026
